overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、收入分配与福利（2 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、实验方法为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（7 篇）、arXiv（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: There Is No Such Thing as Surplus Value: An Explanation of Economic Exploitation
papers.abstract: Usually, when exploring the concept of worker exploitation, we will fall upon the logic of the labor theory of value. Part of a laborer's value is being exploited, a capitalist gets the value of labor that they have not paid for, and so on. But what if it is not labor power that is exploited but the laborer themselves? Ellerman's labor theory of property (and it is Ellerman's theory) identifies exploitation as occurring not in a supposed dividing of the spoils but in the injustice of the employer-employee relationship itself. Following from this, the logic of exploitation does not derive from the employer simply not giving workers enough but because the employer is making a fundamentally unjust claim to the proceeds of production. This paper fleshes out this argument, showing that any claim an employer might make over-and-above those of workers is only an expression of pre-existing state prejudice reflected through the so-called property claim. Following from this, it uses economic and sociological research to explore how hoarding enables the construction of profit and, thus, enables further exploitation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】通常，在探讨工人剥削的概念时，我们会接触到劳动价值论的逻辑。根据这一理论，工人的一部分价值被剥削了，资本家获得了他们并未支付的劳动价值等等。但如果被剥削的不是劳动力，而是工人本身呢？埃勒曼（Ellerman）的财产权劳动理论指出，剥削并非发生在所谓的“战利品分配”过程中，而在于雇主与雇员之间不公正的关系之中。基于这一观点，剥削的逻辑并非源于雇主给予工人的报酬不足，而在于雇主对生产成果提出了根本不公正的要求。本文进一步阐述了这一论点，指出雇主对工人劳动成果的任何额外索取，实际上只是通过所谓的“财产权”这一形式体现出来的既存社会偏见的体现。随后，本文运用经济学和社会学的研究方法，探讨了资本积累（即财富的囤积）如何促成利润的形成，从而进一步加剧了剥削现象。。

papers.title: Dampak Migrasi Tenaga Kerja Terhadap Pembangunan Ekonomi Daerah Asal di Indonesia
papers.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis dampak migrasi tenaga kerja terhadap pembangunan ekonomi daerah asal di Indonesia melalui pendekatan tinjauan literatur (literature review). Metode yang digunakan adalah pengumpulan dan analisis berbagai penelitian terdahulu yang relevan, yang diperoleh dari Google Scholar dan berbagai sumber jurnal nasional, tanpa batasan tahun publikasi. Kajian teoritis dalam penelitian ini mencakup konsep migrasi tenaga kerja, teori push and pull, teori remitansi, serta keterkaitannya dengan pembangunan ekonomi daerah. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa migrasi tenaga kerja memiliki dampak yang bersifat multidimensional. Dampak positif utama terlihat dari peran remitansi sebagai sumber pendapatan yang meningkatkan kesejahteraan rumah tangga, mendorong konsumsi, serta berpotensi menjadi investasi produktif yang mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi lokal. Selain itu, migrasi juga berkontribusi terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi secara makro melalui aliran devisa. Namun, di sisi lain, migrasi menimbulkan dampak negatif berupa berkurangnya tenaga kerja produktif di daerah asal, fenomena brain drain, ketergantungan terhadap remitansi, serta munculnya permasalahan sosial dan ketimpangan. Pembahasan menunjukkan bahwa besarnya dampak migrasi sangat dipengaruhi oleh pola pemanfaatan remitansi, kualitas sumber daya manusia migran, kebijakan pemerintah, serta tingkat literasi keuangan. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan kebijakan yang komprehensif untuk mengoptimalkan manfaat migrasi melalui pemberdayaan berbasis remitansi, reintegrasi migran kembali, serta penguatan ekonomi lokal. Dengan pengelolaan yang tepat, migrasi tenaga kerja dapat menjadi instrumen strategis dalam mendukung pembangunan ekonomi daerah asal secara berkelanjutan.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：该研究旨在分析劳动力迁移对印尼原籍地区经济发展的影响，并探讨其多维度的效应。

🔬 研究方法：研究采用文献综述法，通过收集和分析来自Google Scholar及各类期刊的相关研究，探讨劳动力迁移与地区经济发展的理论联系。

📊 核心发现：研究发现劳动力迁移具有多维影响：正面方面，汇款增加了家庭收入与消费，并可能转化为生产性投资；负面方面，则导致原籍地区熟练劳动力流失（人才流失）及社会不平等问题。

💡 应用价值：研究表明，通过优化汇款管理、加强金融素养及实施包容性政策，可以将劳动力迁移转化为支持原籍地区可持续发展的战略工具。

papers.title: Calibrated Horizon-Weighted Local Projection Designs for Markov Switchbacks
papers.abstract: We study temporal assignment design for Markov switchback experiments when the reported object is a dynamic local-projection target. We develop a calibrated selector that chooses the feasible persistence minimizing the covariance, HAC, residual-bootstrap, or realized-schedule risk of the estimator and reporting object specified before the experiment. A balanced homoskedastic Markov benchmark yields a closed form because the lagged-assignment information matrix is AR(1)-Toeplitz with a tridiagonal inverse. The benchmark maps local-projection reporting weights into persistence recommendations within a prespecified first-order Markov class. Field recommendations replace the benchmark covariance with residualized, serially dependent, pilot-calibrated, or randomization-based risk. A semi-synthetic Low Carbon London evaluation uses observed half-hourly baseline dynamics and known injected responses to assess design risk. It evaluates the covariance calculations under realistic load autocovariance and identifies when calibrated covariance selection should replace the homoskedastic Markov formula. Near-boundary designs use randomization-first inference when many-spell normal approximations are unsupported.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在报告对象为动态局部投影目标的情况下，用于马尔可夫切换实验的时间分配设计方法。我们开发了一种校准选择器，该选择器能够在实验开始前根据估计量和报告对象的特性，选择能够最小化协方差风险、HAC风险、残差自助法风险或实现计划风险的可行分配方案。在平衡的齐次方差马尔可夫模型基准下，由于滞后分配信息矩阵具有AR(1)阶的托普利茨结构且其逆矩阵为三对角矩阵，因此可以得出封闭形式的计算公式。该基准模型将局部投影报告权重映射到预设的一阶马尔可夫类别内的持续性建议中。在实际应用中，人们通常会用基于残差分析、序列依赖性、试点校准或随机化方法的风险评估来替代基准模型中的协方差计算。在半合成的伦敦低碳评估案例中，我们利用观测到的半小时基线动态数据和已知的注入响应来评估设计风险，并在现实负载自协方差条件下评估协方差计算方法的适用性，同时确定何时应使用校准后的协方差选择公式来替代齐次方差马尔可夫模型。在边界附近的设计场景中，当无法使用多词法正态分布近似时，我们会采用随机化优先的推断方法。。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: Robust Welfare Decentralization under Population Entry
papers.abstract: We ask when an incumbent economy with indivisible goods can accommodate an arbitrary new participant while retaining an efficient allocation supported by anonymous item prices. We call this property universal entry robustness. An economy is universally entry-robust if and only if its aggregate welfare valuation is additive. Although the requirement quantifies over all entrant valuations, it can be tested using one canonical entrant whose value for a bundle equals the loss in maximal incumbent welfare caused by removing that bundle. When the characterization holds, one uniquely determined price vector decentralizes the incumbent optimum and every one-agent extension. The proof is direct and uses only demand optimality and welfare comparisons, making transparent why arbitrary-entry robustness eliminates all bundle interactions in aggregate welfare. We finally relate this argument to the robust-integrality interpretation obtained from the linear-programming characterization of Bikhchandani and Mamer (1997). Individual incumbent valuations may be nonadditive and need not satisfy gross substitutes.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】我们探讨了在具有不可分割商品的经济体系中，现有参与者如何在保持匿名物品价格所支持的有效资源配置的前提下，接纳任意新的参与者。我们将这种特性称为“普遍进入鲁棒性”（universal entry robustness）。一个经济体具备普遍进入鲁棒性的充要条件是其总体福利估值具有可加性。尽管这一要求是对所有参与者估值的量化描述，但可以通过一个特定的参与者来进行检验：该参与者的某商品组合的估值应等于移除该组合后现有参与者最大福利的损失。当这一特性成立时，一个唯一确定的价格向量能够使现有参与者的最优配置以及所有单一参与者的扩展配置都得到实现。证明过程直接明了，仅依赖于需求最优性和福利比较，从而清晰地解释了为何普遍进入鲁棒性能够消除总体福利中的所有组合交互效应。最后，我们将这一结论与Bikhchandani和Mamer（1997年）通过线性规划方法得出的“鲁棒完整性”（robust-integrality）解释联系起来。需要注意的是，现有参与者的个体估值可能是非可加的，并且不一定满足“完全替代”（gross substitutes）的条件。。

papers.title: Financial Statement Analysis and its Impact on Investment Decisions in Ghana
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: The objective of the study is to investigate the influence of financial statement analysis on investment decisions among investors in the Ghana Stock Exchange Market. Quantitative research design was employed where data was collected through structured questionnaires issued to both individual and institutional investors on the Ghana Stock Exchange Market. In all a total of ninety-seven (97) valid responses were analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistical tools, including correlation and regression analysis. The findings of the study revealed a strong and statistically significant relationship between financial statement analysis and the quality of investment decisions of investors in the Ghana Stock Exchange Market, particularly emphasizing the importance of profitability and liquidity indicators.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究的目的是探讨财务报表分析对加纳证券交易所投资者投资决策的影响。研究采用了定量研究方法，通过向加纳证券交易所的个人投资者和机构投资者发放结构化问卷来收集数据。共收到97份有效回复，并运用描述性统计和推断性统计工具（包括相关分析和回归分析）对数据进行了分析。研究结果表明，财务报表分析与加纳证券交易所投资者的投资决策质量之间存在显著的正相关关系，尤其是盈利能力指标和流动性指标的重要性得到了突出体现。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Green Governance and Investment Efficiency in the US Firms: The Role of ESG Performance and Financial Constraints
papers.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between environmental, social and governance (ESG) practices, investment efficiency and the moderating effect of financial constraints among S&P 1500 firms from 2010 to 2023. Using generalised method of moments (GMMs) estimators to address endogeneity and heterogeneity, we employ three investment inefficiency proxies and two financial constraint measures (the SA and WW indices). ESG scores are negatively associated with investment inefficiency, suggesting improved capital allocation and this relationship becomes stronger under higher levels of financial constraints. Governance practices are associated with the largest reduction in inefficiency, followed by social and environmental practices.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】本研究探讨了2010年至2023年间标准普尔1500指数公司（S&P 1500 firms）的环境、社会与治理（ESG）实践、投资效率以及财务约束的调节作用之间的关系。为了解决内生性和异质性问题，我们采用了广义矩估计（GMMs）方法，并使用了三种投资效率指标和两种财务约束衡量标准（SA指数和WW指数）。研究结果表明，ESG评分与投资效率呈负相关，表明企业的资本配置得到了改善；且在财务约束较高的情况下，这种负相关关系更为显著。在各种因素中，治理实践对降低投资效率的贡献最大，其次是社会与环境实践。。研究方法：广义矩估计。

papers.title: Heat vulnerability and adaptive self-efficacy: An asymmetric analysis of risk coping
papers.abstract: Heat-related mortality in Europe is concentrated in Mediterranean countries, with Spain among the most affected. Recent work documents a misalignment between objective heat risk and its subjective perception, yet how the coping side of risk appraisal is socially distributed remains unclear. Drawing on protection motivation theory, we examine how objective vulnerability is distributed across three appraisal planes (threat appraisal, response efficacy, and adaptive self-efficacy) in a sample of 1,508 adults in Barcelona, Valencia, and Zaragoza. Personal vulnerability raises threat appraisal (β = 0.13), depresses response efficacy modestly (β = −0.07), and depresses self-efficacy most strongly (β = −0.17); the self-efficacy gradient is significantly steeper (Δβ = −0.09, p = .005). Component mechanisms differ: chronic conditions amplify threat appraisal, economic strain operates across all planes, and limited cooling resources depress self-efficacy. Heat-adaptation policy must make protection materially actionable, not only raise threat awareness.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】欧洲与热相关的死亡事件主要集中在地中海国家，其中西班牙受影响最为严重。最新研究指出，客观上的热风险与人们对这种风险的主观感知之间存在差异，但人们在应对这种风险时的社会行为分布情况仍不明确。基于保护动机理论，我们对巴塞罗那、瓦伦西亚和萨拉戈萨的1,508名成年人进行了研究，探讨了客观脆弱性在三个风险评估维度（威胁评估、应对效能和适应自我效能）上的分布情况。研究发现，个人脆弱性会提高人们对风险的感知（β = 0.13），适度降低应对效能（β = −0.07），并显著降低自我效能（β = −0.17）；其中，自我效能的下降幅度最为显著（Δβ = −0.09，p = .005）。不同因素的作用机制各不相同：慢性疾病会加剧人们对风险的感知；经济压力会对所有评估维度产生影响；而有限的降温资源则会降低人们的自我效能。因此，热适应政策不仅要提高人们对热风险的认知，还要确保相应的保护措施能够切实可行。。

papers.title: Sustainable Nature Tourism Development at Katobung Waterfall: Implications for Local Economic Development and Environmental Conservation
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the impact of the Katobung Waterfall development on the community's microeconomics and regional finances, as well as identify structural constraints to its management in a state forest area. Using a qualitative approach with a phenomenological design, data were collected through in-depth interviews with 12 key informants and field observations. Data analysis employed a modified Moustakas method through the stages of horizontalization and clustering themes using the Common-Pool Resources Theory and Livelihood Framework analysis tools. Field findings indicate that self-help tourism has triggered a diversification of food stall income of Rp150,000 to Rp200,000 every weekend and reduced unemployment through informal transportation services. However, its macro contribution to Regional Original Income (PAD) is zero due to a regulatory void. The local government is hampered in allocating APBD funds for repairs to a 14-kilometer road and sanitation because the location is in a Production Forest area under the auspices of the KPHP. This institutional friction has triggered illegal management, parking conflicts, and garbage accumulation. This research provides a scientific contribution in the form of an antithesis to the classical CBT theory by proving that local control without formal legal certainty and adequate human capital actually traps destinations in the Tragedy of the Commons, thus requiring a Collaborative Sustainable Governance framework.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在分析卡托邦瀑布（Katobung Waterfall）开发对当地社区微观经济和区域财政的影响，并探讨该地区在国有森林管理中面临的结构性制约因素。研究采用质性研究方法（具体为现象学设计），通过深入访谈12位关键信息提供者及实地观察收集数据。数据分析过程中运用了改良版的Moustakas方法，结合“公共资源理论”（Common-Pool Resources Theory）和“生计框架分析”（Livelihood Framework）工具，对收集到的数据进行主题分类与归纳。研究结果表明：自助旅游（self-help tourism）促进了当地小吃摊位的收入增长（每个周末收入增加15万至20万印尼盾），同时通过非正式交通服务减少了失业率；然而，由于监管制度的缺失，该开发项目对区域原始收入（Regional Original Income, PAD）的宏观贡献为零。由于该地区属于KPHP（Kawasan Produksi Hutan）管辖的森林生产区，当地政府在分配用于道路维修和卫生设施建设的APBD（Anggaran Pendapatan Daerah）资金时遇到困难。这种制度...。

papers.title: Development and feasibility of a 3D whole-body protocol with integrated surface documentation in a mobile cone-beam CT system for applications in forensic imaging and disaster victim identification
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Background
                    Postmortem computed tomography plays an important role in modern forensic investigations, particularly in disaster victim identification, where flexible and deployable imaging solutions are required. However, the use of whole-body postmortem computed tomography remains limited by the infrastructure demands of conventional computed tomography systems. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a standardized whole-body imaging protocol for a mobile cone-beam computed tomography system. A dedicated protocol was established in collaboration with the manufacturer through an iterative development process, including dose modulation, infrared tracking, and automated image stitching. The finalized protocol was applied in ten forensic cases. Sequential acquisitions along the longitudinal body axis were combined into a single dataset, while simultaneously acquired optical images were used for photogrammetric surface reconstruction.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    Whole-body imaging was successfully achieved in all cases, providing continuous anatomical coverage from head to feet. Skeletal structures and implanted devices were clearly visualized, with adequate soft tissue depiction for general assessment. Image stitching enabled seamless integration of sequential scans without relevant artifacts. Surface reconstruction was feasible in all cases, although mesh quality was limited by the camera system. In addition, the system enabled rapid acquisition of conventional radiographs and targeted high-resolution imaging of selected regions.
                  
                  
                    Conclusions
                    Mobile cone-beam computed tomography enables feasible whole-body postmortem imaging with integrated surface documentation. The combination of whole-body imaging, targeted acquisitions, radiographic imaging, and simultaneous surface documentation represents a versatile approach for forensic workflows and may be particularly valuable in disaster victim identification scenarios. Further technical refinements and larger studies are warranted.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

**背景**  
死后计算机断层扫描（postmortem computed tomography）在现代法医调查中发挥着重要作用，尤其是在灾难受害者识别领域，这类场景需要灵活且易于部署的成像技术。然而，全身性死后计算机断层扫描的应用受到传统计算机断层扫描系统基础设施要求的限制。本研究旨在为移动式圆锥束计算机断层扫描系统开发并评估一种标准化的成像方案。通过与制造商的协作，通过迭代开发过程（包括剂量调节、红外跟踪和自动图像拼接等技术），最终制定出了一套专用协议。该协议已在十例法医案例中得到应用：沿人体纵轴依次采集的图像数据被整合为单一数据集，同时获取的光学图像被用于表面重建。

**结果**  
所有案例均成功实现了全身成像，实现了从头部到脚部的连续解剖结构覆盖。骨骼结构及植入物清晰可见，软组织也得到了充分显示，便于进行总体评估。图像拼接技术使得连续扫描结果能够无缝融合，且未产生明显伪影。尽管网格质量受相机系统限制，但表面重建在所有案例中均可行。此外，该系统还支持快速获取常规X光片以及对特定区域的高分辨率成像。

**结论**  
移动式圆锥束计算机断层扫描技术实现了具备集...。

papers.title: Education for All or Quality for All? Rethinking Free-School Policy and Nutritional Support in Indonesia
papers.abstract:
The COVID-19 pandemic has intensified a longstanding debate in Indonesian education policy: whether it is more important to widen access to schooling or to improve the quality of learning. This article examines the relationship between two major policy instruments in Indonesian education—free schooling and nutritional support, specifically the Free Nutritious Meals Program (Makan Bergizi Gratis, MBG). Using a systematic literature review combined with interpretive policy analysis, the study draws on evidence from Scopus- and Web of Science-indexed international journals, reports from major global institutions, and Sinta 1- and Sinta 2-accredited national journals. The findings are notable: free schooling has successfully increased enrollment, particularly among children from low-income families, but has not automatically translated into better learning outcomes. School feeding programs, by contrast, show measurable impact—students attend more regularly, concentrate better in class, and achieve higher scores—although the effectiveness of these programs depends heavily on implementation quality. This article rejects the framing that pits access against quality, arguing that the two are not mutually exclusive. Drawing on human capital theory, social protection scholarship, and systems-based policy analysis, the article proposes an integrated policy model that simultaneously expands access, delivers nutritional intervention, and raises education quality. Three elements are emphasized: cross-sectoral coordination, data-driven monitoring, and mutually reinforcing policy design. These findings are relevant not only to Indonesia but also to other developing countries facing similar challenges

Keywords: free schooling; school feeding; education quality; policy integration; Free Nutritious Meals Program
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Education for All or Quality for All? Rethinking Free-School Policy and Nutritional Support in Indonesia。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Framing (construction)、Indonesian、Economic growth」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。

papers.title: THE DYNAMICS OF COPYRIGHT ROYALTY MANAGEMENT FOR SONGS/MUSIC, AND ITS IMPACT ON THE PROTECTION OF CREATIVE RIGHTS
papers.abstract: Indonesia's copyright royalty management system has evolved through the establishment of Collective Management Organizations (LMKs) and the National Collective Management Organization (LMKN), which are responsible for collecting, administering, and distributing royalties to creators. Despite this institutional framework, significant deficiencies continue to undermine the protection of creators' economic rights. This study examines the adequacy of legal protection afforded by the current royalty distribution system and analyzes LMKN's legal responsibility for unclaimed royalties. Using normative legal research with statutory, conceptual, and comparative approaches, the study applies prescriptive legal analysis. The findings indicate that, although the Copyright Law and its implementing regulations govern royalty management, they do not provide sufficient legal certainty regarding timely, transparent, and proportionate royalty distribution based on actual use of copyrighted works. In addition, the absence of clear rules governing LMKN's responsibility for unclaimed royalties weakens legal protection for creators' economic rights. This study proposes reconstructing Indonesia's royalty governance framework by redefining LMKN as a fiduciary administrator responsible for the accurate, transparent, accountable, and timely distribution of royalties. It also recommends mandatory implementation of Music Recognition Technology (MRT) or digital fingerprinting at commercial venues to improve data accuracy and transparency. These reforms would strengthen legal certainty, promote fairness, and enhance the protection of creators' economic rights in Indonesia.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】印度尼西亚的版权使用费管理系统通过建立集体管理组织（LMKs）和国家集体管理组织（LMKN）得以发展，这些组织负责收集、管理和分配给创作者的使用费。尽管有这样的制度框架，但仍存在诸多缺陷，这些缺陷削弱了对创作者经济权利的保护。本研究探讨了现行使用费分配制度所提供的法律保护是否充分，并分析了LMKN在处理未领取的使用费方面所承担的法律责任。研究采用了规范法律研究方法，结合立法、概念分析和比较研究手段，进行了规范性法律分析。研究结果表明，虽然《版权法》及其实施细则对使用费管理进行了规范，但它们未能为基于作品实际使用情况的及时、透明和合理的使用费分配提供足够的法律保障。此外，由于缺乏关于LMKN在未领取使用费方面责任的具体规定，创作者的经济权利在法律上仍缺乏有效保护。本研究建议通过重新定义LMKN的职责，将其视为负责准确、透明、负责任且及时分配使用费的受托管理人，从而重构印度尼西亚的使用费管理框架。同时，研究还建议在商业场所强制实施音乐识别技术（MRT）或数字指纹识别技术，以提高数据准确性和透明度。这些改革将增强法律的可预测性，促进公平性，并进一步提升印度尼西亚对创作者经济权利的保护力度。。

papers.title: Minimizing Benchmark-Relative Drawdown Duration via Occupation Time Penalization
papers.abstract: We study a continuous-time portfolio optimization problem in which an investor is evaluated relative to a non-replicable benchmark and seeks to control the persistence of benchmark-relative underperformance. We introduce a benchmark-relative drawdown-duration criterion that penalizes the expected discounted time spent in unfavorable benchmark-relative performance states. Despite the path dependence induced by benchmark-relative drawdowns, we show that the problem admits a one-dimensional Markovian representation and derive the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation. We obtain an explicit projection-based characterization of the optimal feedback control, establish a verification theorem, and identify geometric settings under which the associated closed-loop reflected diffusion admits a unique strong solution. Our results provide a tractable downside-risk-oriented alternative to classical benchmark-tracking formulations and reveal a novel projection-based control structure for benchmark-relative risk management.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文研究了一个连续时间投资组合优化问题，旨在控制相对于不可复制基准的相对表现不佳的持续性。

🔬 研究方法：通过引入基准相对回撤持续时间标准，利用占用时间惩罚机制，并推导出相关的一维马尔可夫表示和哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程。

📊 核心发现：获得了最优反馈控制的显式投影表征，建立了验证定理，并确定了闭环反射扩散具有唯一强解的几何条件。

💡 应用价值：为经典的基准跟踪公式提供了可处理的下行风险导向替代方案，并揭示了基准相对风险管理的新的基于投影
